Geneformer/scGPT use native embeddings with logistic regression (LR); scGPT uses the declared unstandardized route. ``+ prior'' denotes released weights adapted with 40,000 cellular tasks plus generic replay. Panel-specific draw ranges appear in Table~\ref{tab:s1}. HVG, highly variable gene.\par
\textsuperscript{*} flags likely pretraining exposure: PBMC cells are assessed as likely present for Geneformer-V2 (316M)\citep{chen2026geneformer} and scGPT. Geneformer-V2 corpus records overlap source studies supplying 92.6\% of ZEBRA held-study query cells; this is an upper bound on exact-cell overlap, not verified cell matching. \textsuperscript{(*)} denotes inferred possible overlap of control cells in ZEBRA development (at most 22.3\%). These marks concern cell-expression exposure, not evidence that target labels were seen. Overall starred means include flagged evaluations. Unmarked scores do not certify absence of exposure outside the audited Geneformer/scGPT corpora.
